phone.notes: Blue and white points show in the profile of each Digimon. Making a Digimon from a scan spends the scan, and what is above 100% is born as white points. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Each exercise gives 10 blue points to its own stat (crunches HP, punches ATK, dashes SPD, squats DEF) and the blue points show in the profile of the Digimon.
